subject: The 3 AM chart that broke me
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but I need to tell you something real about why I built this app.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 3 AM here, and I just watched another trader on our live chat revenge-trade his entire week's profit into a single liquidation. I've been there. Staring at a red chart, feeling that knot in your stomach, knowing you're about to make a dumb move but doing it anyway. That was me six months ago.

That night, I built the first version of what became Predictify Coach. Not for a startup. Not for profit. Because I needed someone—something—to talk me out of hitting buy on a falling knife at 3 AM when I was alone, exhausted, and angry at myself. The AI didn't judge me. It just said: Wait. Check the on-chain data. Your emotions are lying to you.

You have that coach in your pocket right now. Open Crypto AI: Trading Analyzer, tap Predictify Coach, and type exactly what you're feeling about a trade you're about to make. It won't tell you what to do. It'll ask you better questions. I promise it'll save you more than the $19.99/month subscription ever cost me.

Go open the app and try it. Even if you don't trade today, just talk to the Coach. See how it calms the noise. P.S. The on-chain data for Bitcoin is screaming accumulation right now—check the Smart Alerts tab before you miss the next move.
